dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: Would you like to play a song? As long as you do your best to keep up with the rhythm and beat, you'll be able to strum up a storm with ease.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzie
dialogues.text: Focus only on the wind around you and the lovely song you wish to play, and all your troubles will surely fade away.

choices.text: I'll give it a go now.

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: No problem. The scores are over here and ready for your perusal.

choices.text: I've got something else to do right now...

response.speaker: Lizzie
response.text: Oh, that's fine... You're welcome back any time, though!
